rules: Michigan treats anyone who buys, sells or deals in 5 or more vehicles in 12 months as a dealer who must be licensed. Keep count if you plan to flip cars.

Salvage is restricted in Michigan. State law says a late-model distressed (salvage) vehicle cannot be bought through a salvage pool, auction or broker without a salvage vehicle agent license. A broker does not remove that rule for you, so check before bidding on any Michigan salvage vehicle.
A salvage vehicle cannot be registered or driven until it is repaired, passes a state salvage inspection and gets a rebuilt title. Scrap or parts-only titles can never go back on the road.
Police and tow auctions sell as-is, often with no keys and no chance to start the car. Never assume you can inspect first unless the auction says so.

The city lists only year, make, model and VIN. Before bidding on one you like, run its VIN through the free NHTSA recall lookup and the NICB VINCheck, and consider a paid history report. A clean result on a free check does not prove a clean history.
This is general information, not legal advice. Confirm with the Michigan Secretary of State before you rely on it.

pallets.intro: First real pallets: fixed-price pallets from GRP Liquidations in Grand Rapids, shipped or picked up. No photos yet. Auction pallet lots near Detroit (PureBid, HiBid, Biddergy, Midwest Auto Auction) still need a browser check.

sources.name: GRP Liquidations
sources.where: Independent reseller. Grand Rapids, 903 Chicago Dr SW. Ships across the US; local pickup.
sources.getNote: Boxes ship (cost at checkout). Pallets are priced with free shipping or a freight quote. Pickup at the Grand Rapids warehouse.
sources.note: Read on its own site Nov 10: a retail store that sells to shoppers and resellers with ordinary add-to-cart checkout; no license or resale certificate is asked for anywhere on the pages read. Not official USPS and it does not name its package sources. Its FAQ excludes pallets and mystery items from returns, and says shipped pallets and truckloads are wire only. In person: cash, card, Venmo, CashApp, Apple Pay, 3% fee on electronic payments. Phone 616-209-8117.

sources.name: Midwest Auto Auction, warehouse liquidation
sources.where: Redford, 14666 Telegraph Rd. Live, in person.
sources.note: Its site says it is always open to the general public. Live auctions on the third Friday of each month at 10 AM. Sells pallets of overstock merchandise along with vehicles and estate goods.
sources.getNote: You haul it from the auction site.

sources.name: MiBid, State of Michigan surplus
sources.where: Online, with pickup in Michigan.
sources.note: The state says the site is open to everyone with a free account. Sells surplus and confiscated property, not store-return pallets, but lots are often sold in bulk.
sources.getNote: Pickup from the state site named on each lot.

sources.name: HiBid Michigan, local auction houses
sources.where: Online, local pickup across Michigan.
sources.note: Checked Nov 10 in the browser: Michigan lot searches for "pallet", "undeliverable", "unclaimed" and "mystery box" showed no store-return or overstock pallets (a pallet of landscaping pavers, estate mystery boxes). Each auctioneer sets its own terms; read them before registering. Auction houses change weekly, so this stays on the check list.
sources.getNote: Most are local pickup. Some auctioneers ship.

sources.name: PureBid MI
sources.where: Flint, 4357 Miller Rd. Online, local pickup.
sources.note: Confirmed on its own terms page Nov 10: anyone 18 or older with a free account can bid. Card on file is charged the winning bid plus buyer premium, any per-item fee and sales tax; the total shows on the item page before you bid. Sold as is. Local pickup in Flint. Mostly single items. Rechecked Nov 10: 449 open lots in 8 nightly auctions, all single store-return items; no lot title says pallet, mail, unclaimed or undeliverable.
sources.getNote: Book a 15 minute pickup slot in Flint.

sources.name: Mid-Michigan Liquidation
sources.where: Bay City, 3838 Patterson Rd.
sources.note: Describes itself as selling pallets to individuals. Sales are announced on its Facebook page. Not verified beyond that page. Nov 10: no website of its own was found, so nothing more could be read without Facebook.
sources.getNote: Pickup in Bay City.

sources.name: Asset Liquidations
sources.where: Warren. Pickup by appointment.
sources.note: Sells single deals to shoppers and runs live shows. Its pallets and truckloads are described as for qualified resellers, so pallets may need a business account.
sources.getNote: Pickup by appointment in Warren. No walk-ins.

sources.name: MAC.BID pallet auctions
sources.where: Pickup locations not confirmed. No Michigan location found yet.
sources.note: Runs pallet auctions of returns and overstock. Its page did not list locations or who may bid.

sources.name: UpLiquidation
sources.where: Ships pallets. Location not confirmed.
sources.note: Review articles say no business license is needed. The same reviews say it takes payment by wire transfer before shipping. Wire payments cannot be reversed, so treat with caution until verified.
sources.getNote: Ships by freight.

sources.name: Liquidation.com
sources.where: Online auctions. Warehouses in Brownsburg IN, Pittston PA, Garland TX, Las Vegas NV and others.
sources.note: Read on its own Buyer FAQ Nov 10: registration is free and each account is verified (up to 72 hours); a credit card and shipping address must be on file to bid. No resale certificate is asked for: sales tax is charged to "any individual or business" unless you file an exemption form. One lot checked showed an 11% buyer's premium. 757 pallet auctions were open; the nearest warehouse is Brownsburg, Indiana (253 lots), then Illinois and Pennsylvania. It also lists Ontario, Canada: those are left out. Set "Show only within" to 300 miles or Any distance to see these lots.
sources.getNote: Freight at your cost, or pickup at the warehouse on lots that allow it.

sources.name: B-Stock (Amazon, Target, Walmart, Home Depot and other store auctions)
sources.where: Online, nationwide.
sources.note: Its own help pages say a state reseller certificate is required to be approved. Left out under your public-only rule.
sources.getNote: Ships by freight. Amazon lots do not allow buyer pickup.

sources.name: Direct Liquidation, 888 Lots
sources.where: Online, nationwide.
sources.note: Several guides say these require a resale certificate to open an account. Left out unless their own sites say otherwise. Via Trading was moved to its own entry on Nov 10.

sources.name: Biddergy
sources.where: Online auctions; pickup at the site named on each lot (Kalamazoo, Sturgis, Garden City and others).
sources.note: Confirmed on its own pages Nov 10: registration is free, you must be 18, and sales tax is charged unless you give an exemption form (a dealer license is optional, for vehicle dealers). Buyer's premium 18% on the weekly Kalamazoo auction (15% for cash-type payment) and 15% on the municipal surplus auction; 7 days to pay and pick up. 13 pallet lots were listed, all business or government surplus (shop lights, motors, police cruiser parts, military cases): 2 in Kalamazoo with bidding opening Nov 11 at 8 AM, 10 in Sturgis MI and 1 in Roselle IL opening Nov 17. Their closing times were not shown yet, so they are not listed as units.

mail.intro: Two kinds of lots. Official: every open lot at the GovDeals Atlanta Surplus Center, which sells unclaimed mail in Postal Service bins, pickup in Atlanta only. Independent reseller: GRP Liquidations in Grand Rapids, fixed-price boxes and pallets that ship or can be picked up; not official USPS. Use "How you get it" to see only shipped lots.
rules: The only official postal source is the USPS Mail Recovery Center in Atlanta. News reports citing the Postal Service say it sells unclaimed items in large lots through GovDeals. Reports also say winners must pick up in Atlanta.

Everything else is a private reseller. "Unclaimed mail" pallets sold locally are usually returns or overstock bought from liquidators. Treat any claim of official USPS, UPS, FedEx or Amazon packages as unproven unless the seller shows where they came from.
Sealed packages are unknown. Nobody can see inside them from a photo, and nothing on this board will guess that valuable items are in there.

Warning signs: guaranteed Apple products or electronics, stock photos, no street address or phone, no refund terms, prices that promise huge resale value, and payment by wire, gift card, crypto or cash app only.
Labels carry people's names and addresses. Remove or destroy them before you resell or show anything. This board never displays recipient names, addresses or tracking numbers.
